entities.summary: Yoshinobu Nisaka is a former governor of Wakayama Prefecture in Japan. He was first elected in 2006 and served for four terms until 2022. Yoshinobu Nisaka was a political leaders from Wakayama (b. 1950-10-02, Wakayama). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to political systems and geopolitics.
